Line.zh: 其不愿随我等而去。 善哉。那我们便使其永属汝身——一小簇忠腐，常伴不离。 它将傍汝左右，令诸般贪疾无以寓于汝体。 康健之契已立
Line.en: It does not wish to leave with us. Very well. Then we shall make it yours forever. A small and faithful rot. It will linger at your side and keep the hungrier sicknesses from finding a home within you. HEALTH BARGAIN STRUCK

It was good seeing you, brave one.

We will meet again...
